mechanisms.evidence: PREVIOUS S11 00:36.375 clips the viewer-left band and has white trim. THIS S11 00:36.375 and THIS S11 00:38.333 show complete, fabric-following bands, mastic cuffs/waist, and the anchor's flared collar, broad stripe and gold chest motif.

PREVIOUS S08 00:26.542 versus THIS S08 00:26.542 shows the shadowed under-hand tail reduced and its boundary bridged into mastic fabric. THIS S08 00:28.500 also has cleaner side contours; the center-opening detail remains unresolved.

Single-garment continuity still fails: THIS S08 00:26.542 has a compact collar, high closure and straight hem; THIS S06 00:16.708 shows navy forearm panels; THIS S09 00:30.458 retains white ribbing. Corrected S11 does not resolve these contrasts; S08 deviates most.

review.readiness_reason: Major S08 construction, S09 waist-trim and cross-shot branding discrepancies remain, so the hook's single-garment mechanism is not acceptable.
review.summary: S11 now matches the approved construction. S08's hem cleanup improves, with one center-opening detail uncertain. The hook still reads as different garment variants: S08 is the strongest construction outlier, while S09 retains conspicuous white waist ribbing.

defects.description: UNCERTAIN (confidence 0.25): A thin pale extension remains at the lower center opening; these samples do not distinguish residual shirt material from legitimate zipper tape or hardware.
defects.evidence: PREVIOUS S08 00:28.500 shows an outer-right pale island and central strip; THIS S08 00:28.500 removes the outer island but retains a narrow light projection at the center split.
defects.recommended_action: Inspect the native composite against the shirt, garment and zipper layers at this instant. Extend the repair only if the projection is confirmed shirt residue; preserve legitimate closure hardware.

defects.description: S08 remains a different construction: compact stand collar, higher closure and straight split-front hem instead of the approved flared collar and shaped waist. Its exposed sleeve treatment also conflicts with S06.
defects.evidence: THIS S08 00:24.583 and THIS S08 00:28.500 retain the compact neckline and straight lower body through the turn. Unlike THIS S06 00:16.708, the exposed crossed sleeves show thin seams rather than broad navy panels.
defects.recommended_action: Rebuild S08 from the approved on-artist construction, correcting collar, closure and waist together. Reconcile sleeve-panel placement against the same reference while preserving the real performance and hand occlusions.

defects.description: Broad white ribbed waist trim persists, and the cuffs use knit ribbing rather than the approved plain mastic finish. The contrasting waistband prevents continuity with the corrected anchor-matching jacket.
defects.evidence: THIS S09 00:29.833 and THIS S09 00:30.458 retain the bright waist strip and cuff channels across the lean; THIS S11 00:36.375 has mastic fabric finishes without the white ribbed section.
defects.recommended_action: Replace S09's knit trim with the approved mastic fabric construction and propagate it through the crossed-arm poses; avoid another pasted horizontal cover patch.

defects.description: Wearer-left chest branding changes from narrow pale single-line lettering to a broader stacked gold motif. Relative scale and placement within the navy stripe differ; S11 follows the approved realization, while the other sampled rolls do not.
defects.evidence: THIS S06 00:20.625 and THIS S08 00:24.583 place light lettering toward the outer chest band; THIS S11 00:36.375 shows deeper navy coverage with stacked gold embroidery positioned farther inward.
defects.recommended_action: Use the approved on-artist embroidery layout, color and garment-relative placement across the hook shots. Preserve the corrected S11 reference rather than matching it back to inconsistent branding.

defects.description: An additional gold embroidery-like island appears separately from the main pale wordmark, breaking sampled branding consistency during the crossed-arm passage.
defects.evidence: THIS S09 00:31.125 contains a small gold dash nearer the zipper inside the navy band, alongside the outer pale wordmark; THIS S09 00:29.833 shows no corresponding extra mark.
defects.recommended_action: Remove the non-anchor island inside the chest stripe and track a single approved embroidery element through the remaining S09 poses.
